changelog:
Initial release of mneme-vision skill.

- Enables local indexing and search of photo and video libraries.
- Supports natural-language and visual similarity search across media.
- Handles GPU status and memory management for intensive workflows.
- Returns media results as rich content cards when supported.
- Ensures strong privacy: does not upload media to cloud unless explicitly requested.
summary: Use local visual memory tools to index and search photos and videos from creator media libraries.
